queries.Systematic Investigation: We will conduc: Systematic benchmarking of evaluation metrics for protein generative models, analyzing reliability, sensitivity to sample size, model choice, and controlled perturbations for quality, diversity, and distributional similarity metrics.
queries.Quality Metrics Analysis: We will analyz: Evaluation of protein generative model quality metrics pLDDT perplexity pseudoperplexity self-consistency perplexity sample size sensitivity correlations dependence on structure prediction protein language models undertraining detection
queries.Diversity Metrics Evaluation: We will ut: Cluster density diversity metric for protein sequence generative models using MMseqs2 sequence clustering at 50% and 95% similarity thresholds to evaluate broad diversity and mode collapse across distinct protein sequence families
queries.Distributional Similarity Metrics Assess: Evaluation of distributional similarity metrics including Improved Precision and Recall, Density and Coverage, Maximum Mean Discrepancy, Fréchet Distance, and Earth Mover's Distance for protein generative models using protein language model embeddings of varying sizes to assess how embedding model choice affects metric behavior.
queries.Protein Quality Framework: Our approach: Protein generative model evaluation framework using structural self-consistency and bidirectional sequence-structure folding inverse folding to assess protein quality without relying solely on single predictor scores
queries.Training Progress Simulation: Using the: Protein generative model evaluation using SwissProt sequences with controlled amino acid substitution noise preserving amino acid distribution, noise levels from 0 to 30 percent in 5 percent increments, to simulate undertrained generation and assess sensitivity of quality, diversity, and distributional similarity metrics to known degradation.
queries.Diversity Assessment Setup: We will cons: Evaluating protein sequence generative model diversity using controlled perturbations of distinct protein family clusters, including cluster elimination for mode collapse, cluster imbalance, and intra-cluster duplication, to assess diversity metrics such as cluster density and MMseqs2 clustering.
queries.Sample Size Sensitivity Analysis: We wil: How does sample size affect the reliability of protein generative model evaluation metrics under controlled amino acid perturbation levels, and what minimum number of generated sequences is required for stable pLDDT, perplexity, diversity, and distributional similarity estimates?
queries.Model Comparison Studies: We will invest: How do structure prediction models AlphaFold ESMFold OmegaFold, protein language models ESM-2 ProtT5, and autoregressive models ProtGPT2 ProGen2 RITA affect pLDDT, distributional similarity, and perplexity metrics for evaluating protein generative models
queries.Parameter Optimization: We will conduct: Sensitivity of maximum mean discrepancy with RBF kernel bandwidth sigma to kernel tuning in protein generative model evaluation, including controlled sequence corruption, GPT2 training progression, and protein language model embedding comparisons.
queries.Real-world Validation: We will test our: Real-world validation of systematic protein generative model evaluation metrics on outputs from state-of-the-art protein generators for quality diversity distributional similarity
